question: Related Questions Q. If we make sadka e jariya its ajar we get after death till that act is continued is it same in case of zakat? Did we recive its ajar after death till that act is continue? 2344 views Q. We would like to ask a Shari Ruling regarding rent for a Madrasah which is based at an Islamic Secondary school building, the Islamic Secondary school building was opened by the current Chairman and the current Vice Chairman (a committee was later made on the bases that they would be supportive). Currently the Madrasah uses three classes in the evening for Madrasah. The Madrasah currently pay?s rent. But the issue has arisen about rent for the Madrasah when it first opened in 2004. Before the Madrasah opened, eminent scholars gave Mushwerah that the building was not used in the evenings and it would be suitable for evening Madrasah, through this it was then decided by the Chairman that the building can be used without any rent being paid, this was due to the Madrasah being new and to get the Madrasah running, at this time none of the Governors of the school were active in the daily issues of the school. From 2006 due to some issues (regarding the Islamic Secondary school) the Governors of the school got involved and they raised the issue of rent and they decided that rent should be back dated to (2004) and paid to the date of when payment first started (which was 2006). According to Shariah is it compulsory to for the Madrasah to pay the backdated rent? 1764 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 791 Country: Bangladesh Title: Is it permissible for a group to claim preferential rights over managing a mosque based on ancestral land ownership? Question: Respected Shaikh, Assalamu Aly Kum, Q:there is a mosque in our society, which was founded 80 to 100 years before.A part of the society,always claim that the mosque was constructed on there land so they have the upper hand to handle the affairs of mosque; in other words- they try to dictate the terms and try to get the preference in any affair of the mosque.So, there has always been disagreement and discord in one way or the other among the parties in handling the affairs. Recently, the discord has gone to such an extyreme limit that has broken the saocity apart.One of the factions, has constructed a new mosque very close the old one-regular as well as juma prayers are offered there. My question is- what is the ruling about the new mosque? Is the new mosque could be considered as legal according to sharia?it seems, bothe the factions may never reconcile, at present i dont subscribe to anyone. May i offer prayer in both the mosque? May i contribute in both the mosque for development? Thanking you! Answer ID: 791 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 961=712/H) It is permissible to pray in both the mosques and to donate to them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
